A '''clone trooper''' served in [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], a [[unit]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] was [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|captured]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] was dispatched to the planet. Under the command of [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]], Green [[Company/Legends|Company]] and the trooper were assigned to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to oversee the transfer of Gunray. However, the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|attacked]] the ''Tranquility'', under orders from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to either [[Death/Legends|kill]] or rescue Gunray. Several [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding ships]] penetrated the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ship and released [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] into its [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. Green Company was sent to repel the intruders, and during the ensuing firefight, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was injured. He remained in the hangar, where he spotted Ventress, who had jumped out from a [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding craft]]. The trooper tried to report her presence, but he was unable to finish his report before being decapitated by the Dark Acolyte.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Trooper! What have you found? Come in, trooper! Do you copy?|A clone trooper tries to contact the Green Company trooper after his report is cut short|audio=ComeInTrooper-CoD.flac|<ref name="db" />}}
[[File:BaldyIsCharging-CoD.png|thumb|left|320px|The clone trooper watches as Ventress charges at him.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="db" /> a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] served in [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], a [[unit]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="cod" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Confederate leader [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] was [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|captured]] on the planet[[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="bj">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> Under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]], Green Company, including the trooper, were assigned to oversee the transfer of Gunray. The [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] was sent to Rodia to escort the captured Gunray to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="cod" /> The leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems,<ref name="Dooku">{{DB|character|countdooku|Dooku, Count}}</ref> [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], sent the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to the ''Tranquility'' to either [[Death/Legends|kill]] or rescue Gunray, who possessed valuable Confederate secrets.<ref name="cod" />

Soon after departing Rodia, the ''Tranquility'' was [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|attacked]] by several Confederate [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding ships]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ships]] penetrated the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], and several [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] disembarked from the [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding ships]]. The [[Unidentified clone naval captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Tranquility'' informed CC-1004 of the attack, who in turn ordered the clone trooper and Green Company to repel the enemy in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay of the Star Destroyer. Under the command of [[Green Leader (clone trooper)/Legends|Green Leader]], the trooper, together with his [[Company/Legends|company]], raced toward the hangar, where they assumed defensive posts. The company was, however, overwhelmed and forced to retreat toward the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] level. The clone trooper, who was lying in the hangar after being wounded during the firefight, spotted Ventress, who dropped out of one of the boarding ships.<ref name="cod" /> He<ref name="EG Cloak" /> tried to report the presence of the approaching Dark Acolyte to the other clone troopers via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], but was unable to finish his report before being [[Sai cha|beheaded]] and killed by Ventress. The Dark Acolyte stole his comlink and used it to spy on the clones as she made her way toward Gunray.<ref name="cod" />

==Personality and traits==
The clone stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
The clone wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|green]] trim and wielded a [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]]. He also had a comlink.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper first appeared in "[[Cloak of Darkness]],"<ref name="cod" /> an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. In the episode, which aired on [[December 5]], [[2008]], the clone was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voiced all clone troopers in the show.<ref name="EG Cloak" />
